spanish: Y cuando acerques ofrenda de minjá, cocido de horno, sólet, tortas ázimas amasadas en el aceite, y obleas ázimas untadas en el aceite.

findings.issue: minjá leaves the common noun H4503 untranslated; common nouns stay Spanish
sólet leaves the common noun H5560 untranslated; common nouns stay Spanish
סֹלֶת is construct and governs חַלּוֹת; the comma lists sólet as a separate item and drops that link
amasadas specializes the qal passive of H1101 (mixed) as kneading
cuando selects a temporal sense of the conjunction כִּי, which the morphology leaves open

notes: Construct de on ofrenda and horno, the article on both aceites, and 2ms acerques match the tokens.
